text: 近日，全球最大汽车零部件供应商博世宣布，将德国境内的移动出行（Mobility）业务，与博世数字化、全球商务服务、全球房地产三个服务单元一道，分别从罗伯特·博世有限公司转入独立的法律实体，作为集团全资子公司运营；集团总部转型为控股公司，只保留集团融资、中央研究与先期工程职能。新实体将于2027年8月1日开始运作，整体调整在2027年底前分阶段完成。 不过，这次分拆不影响中国市场业务，博世中国内部人士表示，此次调整是集团德国本土的架构统一，不针对中国等地区，中国的业务布局和投入不受影响。（第一财经）
text_en: Recently, Bosch, the world's largest auto parts supplier, announced that it will transfer its Mobility business in Germany, together with three service units—Bosch Digital, Global Business Services and Global Real Estate—from Robert Bosch GmbH into separate legal entities to operate as wholly owned subsidiaries of the group; the group headquarters will be transformed into a holding company, retaining only group financing and central research and advanced engineering functions. The new entities will begin operating on August 1, 2027, with the overall adjustment to be completed in stages by the end of 2027. However, this spin-off does not affect business in the Chinese market. An insider at Bosch China said that this adjustment is a unification of the group's structure within Germany and is not targeted at China or other regions, and that China's business layout and investment will not be affected. (Yicai)
